title: Quotient and remainder update
statement: Let $Q,\rho,v,c,P,T,a\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $c\le1$, $(Qv+\rho)(2P)+(T+cP)=a$, and $\rho<v$. If $v\le c+2\rho$, then $((1+2Q)v+(c+2\rho-v))P+T=a$ and $c+2\rho-v<v$. If $v\nleq c+2\rho$, then $(2Qv+(c+2\rho))P+T=a$ and $c+2\rho<v$.
replaced:
Let $Q,\rho,v,c,P,T,a$ be natural numbers with $c\leq 1$, $(Qv+\rho)(2P)+(T+cP)=a$, and
$\rho<v$. If $v\leq c+2\rho$, then $((1+2Q)v+(c+2\rho-v))P+T=a$ and $c+2\rho-v<v$. If
$v\nleq c+2\rho$, then $(2Qv+(c+2\rho))P+T=a$ and $c+2\rho<v$.
